I investigated the population of Spain as of late November 2023. According to provisional data from Spain's National Statistics Institute (INE) reported on November 8, 2023, the population was 48,446,594 as of October 1, 2023. This figure is approximately 48.4 million.

I investigated the population of Germany as of late November 2023. Based on data from Destatis (the German Federal Statistical Office), the population was approximately 83.46 million (specifically 83,456,045). This figure reflects the official statistics for the year 2023.
